title: Welcome Gateway: compact hero + journey strips for Quickstart landing
creator: Maya Chen
description: Objective: design a compact, scannable hero and a set of horizontal "journey strips" for the Quickstart landing that communicate the path from sign-up -> first API call -> runtime observability. This ticket covers visual exploration, annotated specs for engineering, localized screenshots, and a handoff package for docs and marketing. The visuals must read well at small sizes, be screen-capture friendly, and match Redwood’s voice: pragmatic, developer-first, production-ready.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Hero variants: full-width (desktop) and compact stacked (mobile) artboards in Figma with color tokens and responsive spacing.
2) Journey strips: three horizontal strips (Onboard, Integrate, Observe) with iconography, one-line step copy, and micro-screenshots.
3) Assets: export-ready SVGs, PNGs (2x) for screenshots, and a screenshot capture checklist for engineering.
4) Annotated spec: spacing, type scale, token names, and accessible color contrasts.
5) Docs-ready images: filenames and captions prepared for docs repo; PR created linking visuals to quickstart page.
6) UX review sign-off from PM and two engineering stakeholders.
tasks: Iterate hero art choices: code-diagram motif vs. product-screenshot motif
Produce three journey strip layouts and pick primary
Produce localized screenshot captures for en-US and de-DE
Create component tokens and CSS variables for engineering handoff
Prepare image optimization checklist for docs pipeline
Open docs PR linking images and captions
review_notes:
2026-02-18: PM Aisha Kapoor prefers product-screenshot motif for trust; engineering (Diego Martinez) raised concerns about screenshot maintenance for every release. Decision: use a hybrid approach — stylized screenshot background with overlaid live-data microcards to reduce re-captures.
2026-03-02: Accessibility review: contrast of teal callout chip fails AA at 12px; adjusted to darker teal token.
2026-03-10: Design critique: narrow-width hero loses presence on 1366px screens; increased max-width to 1200px and tightened horizontal padding.
